question: 分析最近一周的网络攻击，重点关注高风险攻击和外部IP，评估风险等级
sql_query:
SQLQuery:  
```sql
SELECT 
    `ids_ai`.`event_time`, 
    `ids_ai`.`src_ip`, 
    `ids_ai`.`dst_ip`, 
    `ids_ai`.`threat_level`, 
    `ids_ai`.`signature`, 
    `ip_address`.`network_type`, 
    CASE WHEN `ip_address`.`network_type` IS NULL THEN 'external' ELSE 'internal' END AS `ip_type`
FROM 
    `ids_ai`
LEFT JOIN 
    `ip_address` ON `ids_ai`.`src_ip` = `ip_address`.`ip`
WHERE threat_level >= 30 AND  
    (`ids_ai`.`threat_level` >= 30 OR `ip_address`.`network_type` IS NULL)
AND 
    `ids_ai`.`event_time` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
ORDER BY 
    `ids_ai`.`event_time` DESC;
```
